caseName: Dexter Horton & Co. v. London & San Francisco Bank

opinions.text: April 11, 1904. Petition for a writ of certiorari to the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. denied. Mr. William E. Humphrey for petitioner. Mr. Charles E. Shepard and Mr. Thomas P. Shepard for respondent.
